The '''Sullustan Corridor''' was a trade route that ran by the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]]. It eventually combined with the [[Hidakai Pool]], forming the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
